g.title: legend
g.text: the dydra credential. Authenticated per request
per resource, then again at transaction creation.
the provider credential. Reaches the Messages API
= the user's authority ∩ ALLOW_TOOLS ∩ the grant. The
model has no credential and no route to the endpoint;
it asks, and R6 is the browser answering on its behalf.
runs only in the dashboard frame: opaque origin, no
credential, no network. `script-src' there is permissive
because there is nothing in the frame worth stealing and
no way to send it anywhere.
token of R0b is permanent, unscoped and account-wide.
Both are what OAuth scopes would move to the server —
on the blue boundary only. See
R6e: whatever the model surveys is sent to the
provider. Repository read authority is not a bound on
